column1: # Explanations for "why" questions (roadmap 2.4): what each one explains, and the live card it is
# shown with. The text, in each language, is in explanations_<lang>.tsv.
# field and scope say which trend question an explanation answers: "why does atomic radius increase
# down a group" resolves atomic_radius and a down-the-group phrase, and finds radius-down-group. A
# blank field means the explanation is reached by its trigger phrases alone. scope is group, period
# card is drawn from the app's own data when the explanation is shown:
#   trend:<field>:group=<n> | period=<n> | series=<series>   a line across that set (2.3); the series as SeriesId names it
#   trend:<field>:table                                      a heat map of the whole table (2.3)
